capabilities.summary: Native pair of @rightkit/hooks: typed Claude Code and Codex hook payloads, a deadline-bound dispatcher that always exits 0, exact per-event output builders, and emitted/observed delivery receipts.
policyNotes: Declaration-only: no precise implementation fingerprint; never enforced ownership or verified integration.
Shares the lifecycle-hooks capability with @rightkit/hooks (JS). Unlike the JS bin, the Rust dispatcher exits 0 on every internal failure.
Codex PreToolUse denials exit 2 with the reason on stderr (the shipped Legion shape); every other failure prints nothing and exits 0.
